description: This PHP source file defines the AgencyServiceImpl class, which extends BaseServiceImpl to provide methods for managing agency objects, including create, modify, delete, and retrieve statistics and details within the Revive Adserver project.

classes.name: AgencyServiceImpl
classes.description: A class extending BaseServiceImpl that provides methods to add, modify, delete, and retrieve statistics and details of agencies in the Revive Adserver system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the AgencyServiceImpl instance and its internal OA_Dll_Agency object.

methods.name: _validateResult
methods.description: Checks if an operation result is successful; raises an error if not.

methods.name: addAgency
methods.description: Creates a new agency with provided data if session is valid.

methods.name: modifyAgency
methods.description: Modifies an existing agency if session is valid and agencyId is set.

methods.name: deleteAgency
methods.description: Deletes an agency by ID if session is valid.

methods.name: getAgencyDailyStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves daily statistics for an agency over a specified period.

methods.name: getAgencyAdvertiserStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves advertiser statistics for an agency over a specified period.

methods.name: getAgencyCampaignStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves campaign statistics for an agency over a specified period.

methods.name: getAgencyBannerStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves banner statistics for an agency over a specified period.

methods.name: getAgencyPublisherStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves publisher statistics for an agency over a specified period.

methods.name: getAgencyZoneStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves zone statistics for an agency over a specified period.

methods.name: getAgency
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific agency.
